ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the picture is a food chain from left to right: the small aquatic organism on the far left has an arrow pointing to a smaller fish; this smaller fish has an arrow pointing to the larger fish in the middle; the larger fish in the middle then has an arrow pointing to the longer fish on the right side; finally the arrow points to a bird. There are no clearly readable text labels in the picture directly marking which fish is “carnivore fish” or “herbivore fish”. Reasoning: Food chain arrows usually indicate from the one being eaten toward the predator. Based only on the image, it cannot be uniquely confirmed from the labels which fish is “carnivore fish”; but if according to the food chain relationship indicated by the question, carnivore fish eats the preceding link fish that the arrow points from toward it. The corresponding answer should be herbivore fish.
